description: Get several places at once, like jsonx_get for each, in order (for plain data use json_multi_get). The options apply to every place: follow: true goes through $ref on the way; resolve: true returns values with $ref/$env resolved. One line per place: PATH, a TAB, then the value as one line of JSON (or the "[too big] ..." line, or "[error] CODE reason" for that place). One failing does not stop the others; if any failed the last line is "jsonx_multi_get: error: PlacesFailed ...". Example: {"paths": ["fsm.json#/states/think", "tools.json#/tools/math"], "follow": true}.

paths.description: the places, each FILE#/POINTER in one string (as in jsonx_get); at least one

follow.description: true = for every place, go through $ref on the way to the value

resolve.description: true = for every place, resolve $ref/$env inside the value

max_bytes.description: per place: print the value only if its one-line JSON is at most this many bytes (default: env AOS_JSON_MAX_BYTES, else 8000)

full.description: true = print every value however big
